classes.title: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 33:10
precepts.why:
Genesis 2:7 says “the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground.” People talk about evolution, that man came up from primates and formed over time into what we know today; that is not true. Everything in Israel United in Christ is done to edify the nation, and what we say we prove out of the word of God. Ecclesiasticus 33:10 is the second witness: “And all men are from the ground, and Adam was created of earth.”

Some will ask how we know man was made from the dust, since that is not what the white man’s science says. Science is only good if it goes with the Bible; if it contradicts the Bible, we don't give a damn about science. But the honest science agrees. The infographic From Dust to Dust, the elements that connect us to Earth, shows that the human body is made mainly of elements also found in soil. The six main elements of life, carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus and sulfur, are in every cell, molecule and structure of the body and make up over 99 percent of our mass. The essential minerals, calcium for bones and teeth, potassium for the muscles and heart, magnesium, sodium and chlorine, are the same nutrients the soil gives the plants. The trace elements, iron for carrying oxygen, zinc for the immune system and healing, silicon and manganese, are in the soil too. We come from the earth, and to the earth we return, just like the Bible says.

The Most High is a mastermind, the author of beauty, the creator of all things, and he knew what he was doing when he pulled Adam from the dust of the ground. Our bodies are a testament that his word is true. The Bible is a true book, and we don't give a damn what anybody has to say about how our God, our father, created us. The teaching that man came from primates is there to contradict God’s word, because they know our God is a black man.

Paul says the same: “The first man is of the earth, earthy,” and “As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy.” Adam was earthy, and so are we; we come from the same soil as our father Adam, and “as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.” Meanwhile the other nations make sure we are deficient in these very things, and much of the food we eat diminishes them to kill us faster. So it is important, brothers and sisters, to keep a healthy diet.

classes.title: Respect: The Evidence Of Her Faith

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 9:9
precepts.why:
“It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.” A help meet is someone to help him through his daily chores and through living, something to his liking, something for him. God first brought every beast and fowl to Adam, and Adam named them all, because he was over them. Then it says, “but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.” Nothing yet was just for him.

So “the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam”, took one of his ribs, “made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.” This is the Most High doing this for his son, and that is a gift. The gift still remains today for every man. That is why we call her your rib: there is a woman made just for you, because it is not good for man to be alone.

Solomon says what to do with that gift: “Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun”. Living joyfully takes application. It is something you have to make happen.

He goes on: “for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.” God made this woman for you. She is the portion you have been given in this life and in all the work you do under the sun, so receive her as the gift she is and live joyfully with her.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 11:8-9
precepts.why:
Adam said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.” Just as Adam had dominion over the creatures he named, he named her. So there is no confusion about why the woman was made, Paul says: “For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.” “Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.”

People debate and say we all come from the woman, so how can the man be over her? They do not know the Bible. The woman came from the man. That is thus saith the Lord; argue with God. God created the woman for the man, and nobody can create or remake their own purpose in life.

So many people, men and women, spend their lives fighting against their God-given purpose. It is self-sabotage: you will destroy your whole house trying to be something you are not. And you wonder why you are dealing with spirits of depression and anxiety and always on edge: it is because you are fighting against your God-given role. You cannot change it, and trying only brings confusion.

Out of all the beasts of the field there was nothing fit for the man, so God made him a woman, and that woman has a purpose: help meet for her husband. Sometimes the help starts to think she is the purpose, that she is the house. No: you are the help meet for me and my house. The sooner you accept the truth, the sooner there will be peace in your home and peace within yourself; turmoil comes when you leave that place.

That is where it all went left. Eve knew the rule, but the serpent spoke to what was already within her: “ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.” She wanted the position that was over her. Paul goes back to the beginning for the same reason: “For Adam was first formed, then Eve.” “And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.” And Sirach says, “Of the woman came the beginning of sin, and through her we all die.” All she had to do was stay in her role and in order.

You might think it too far-fetched that your beloved wife, the mother of your children, the woman who takes care of you, could have the goddamn devil over you while you sleep. But the first woman, the first created by God himself, was susceptible to the devil. You think your wife ain't? That is why the head has to keep reminding them of their place and role in the home.
